title: Procedure binding facet
description: A new, extensible binding on the content atom for procedural / quality (SOP) source. Owner (single-writer): the Authoring / Headwater agent. Carries the execution semantics an SOP step needs that object/intent/expression/audience do not. Everything here is a REFERENCE (roles, records, cited docs) or a governed label — never embedded prose; the one embedded payload stays meaning.source_text (the action instruction). Attach under bindings.procedure. Applies to atoms whose meaning.kind is 'procedure' (container) or 'procedure_step' (leaf).

step_type.$comment: Canonical source: vocab/procedure.enum.json (dimensions.step_type). This enum is a mirror kept in sync by conformance check; the vocab wins.
step_type.description: GOVERNED closed list. action = do a thing; decision = a branch point (uses `branches`); verification = a QC/acceptance check (uses `acceptance_ref`). Container atoms omit this.

performed_by.description: WHO executes — references into a governed roles vocab. Roles, never people: no PII.

produces_records.description: Record/evidence ids this step generates (the GxP proof it happened). References into a records registry.

references.description: Cited controlled documents / regulations / other atoms. References, not copies.

acceptance_ref.description: For step_type=verification: the acceptance-criterion atom (its own meaning). Criterion prose is meaning, so it lives as a referenced atom — not embedded here.

branches.description: For step_type=decision: the conditional edges prerequisites can't express (if X → step A, else → step B).

on.description: Short governed outcome label for the condition (the human-readable condition is the meaning of the decision step itself).

leads_to.description: The next step atom this outcome routes to.
